import hashlib,json,statistics
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
import llama_cpp._llama as _llama
from llama_cpp import Llama,LlamaConfig,disable_logging
from tools.benchmark_memory import GpuMemorySampler
from tools.benchmark_upstream import generation_run,gpu_query,prompt_tokens
from tools.check_runtime import runtime_info

disable_logging()
main=json.loads(Path('docs/benchmarks/2026-10-13-mtp-width-sweep.json').read_text())
baseline=next(c for c in main['cases'] if c['requested_prompt_tokens']==512 and c['draft_max']==0)['native']['runs'][0]['tokens']
path=main['config']['model_path']
h=hashlib.sha256()
with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
 for data in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''): h.update(data)
assert h.hexdigest()==main['model_sha256']
report={'completed':False,'runtime':runtime_info(),'model_sha256':main['model_sha256'],'native_extension_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(_llama.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'experiment_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cases':[]}
output=Path('docs/benchmarks/2026-10-13-mtp-width-controls.json')
memory=GpuMemorySampler()
try:
 for width,rs,monitored,n in [(0,4,False,3),(2,4,False,5),(2,4,True,5),(1,4,True,3),(3,4,True,3),(2,2,False,5),(2,2,True,3)]:
  cfg=LlamaConfig(model_path=path,n_ctx=8192,n_batch=512,n_ubatch=512,n_rs_seq=rs,n_threads=4,n_threads_batch=4,n_gpu_layers=-1,verbose=False)
  case={'draft_max':width,'n_rs_seq':rs,'memory_sampling':monitored,'config':asdict(cfg),'gpu_before':gpu_query('pstate,temperature.gpu,power.draw,clocks.current.graphics,clocks.current.memory'),'warmup_runs':[],'runs':[]}
  with Llama(path,config=cfg) as llm:
   if width: assert llm.supports_speculative_mtp()
   tokens=prompt_tokens(llm,512)
   case['prompt_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(tokens).encode()).hexdigest()
   for i in range(2+n):
    if monitored: memory.start()
    try: record=generation_run(llm,tokens,256,width)
    finally:
     peak=memory.finish() if monitored else None
    record['memory']=peak
    case['warmup_runs' if i<2 else 'runs'].append(record)
  case['gpu_after']=gpu_query('pstate,temperature.gpu,power.draw,clocks.current.graphics,clocks.current.memory')
  case['median_tokens_per_second']=statistics.median(r['tokens_per_second'] for r in case['runs'])
  case['matches_ordinary']=all(r['tokens']==baseline for r in case['warmup_runs']+case['runs'])
  report['cases'].append(case)
  output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
  print('width',width,'rs',rs,'monitor',monitored,round(case['median_tokens_per_second'],1),'match',case['matches_ordinary'],flush=True)
finally:
 memory.close()
report['completed']=True
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert all(c['matches_ordinary'] for c in report['cases'])
